# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 46 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 39 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_046_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 46

**1** Jesus said: "From Adam to John the Baptist, no one born of a woman has risen so high that John would need to look up to them.

**2** But I tell you: whoever among you becomes like a little child will know the kingdom — and that one will be greater than John."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Risen so high that John would need to look up to them" — the eye-idiom rendered as spatial hierarchy
- "Will be greater than John" — surpassing John expressed simply
